result.summary: The page is largely intact. Aside from the intentionally scrollable carousels and bottom-cut-off content, the only visible problem is a low-contrast star rating icon on the restaurant card.

issues.description: The yellow star rating icon next to the 4.8 score is placed against a plain background with no dark or high-contrast backdrop, making it difficult to see and interpret.
issues.suggestion: Give the star badge a darker background chip or place it on a dark badge so the yellow star remains clearly visible against the light card background.
